design.tokens-only.rule: No hex or rgb() colours, Tailwind palette classes, arbitrary [..] values, or hard-coded fontSize/fontFamily in src/. Use semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted) and Text variants.
design.tokens-only.why: A literal colour has no dark-mode value and skips contrast:check; an arbitrary value escapes the type scale and spacing.

design.contrast.rule: Every token pair meets WCAG AA in both themes (text 4.5:1, icons and outlines 3:1), including placeholder, pressed fills, solid fills under the Android ripple and icon glyphs; every colour token exists in light and dark. Disabled text is exempt, and so are the documented transient pressed states (see the design-system skill).
design.contrast.why: Fading a white-on-blue button for its iOS pressed state drops it from 5.17:1 to 3.62:1; a token missing from one theme renders as nothing in it.

design.ui-primitives.rule: No raw Pressable, Text, TextInput, Button, TouchableOpacity, TouchableHighlight or TouchableWithoutFeedback from react-native outside src/components/ui; the UI kit imports only from @/lib and its own folder.
design.ui-primitives.why: The kit owns tokens, testIDs, accessibility and the platform press feedback; a raw primitive skips all of them, and kit imports of stores or services make it unshareable.

design.testids.rule: Interactive elements have a testID in kebab-case (<screen>-<element>).
design.testids.why: E2E tests and agents select by testID; label text is unreliable in React Native and differs per platform.

design.font-scaling.rule: Never allowFontScaling={false} and never adjustsFontSizeToFit on labels. Text caps scaling per role instead.
design.font-scaling.why: Shrinking or freezing text locks out Dynamic Type AX users and Android users at 200%; HIG says reflow, don't shrink.
